## 

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(googlesheets4)
library(here)

# Public sheet — no Google login required
gs4_deauth()

```


```{r}
#| label: data
#| echo: false

# 2023–2025 from local Excel; 2026 from Google Sheet (Finse_2026 only)
xlsx_path <- here("data", "Reproducibility_2025.xlsx")

dat23 <- read_excel(xlsx_path, sheet = "Hjerkinn_2023") |>
  select(Journal, `Is the data available?`, "Is the code to run the analysis for Fig/Tab x available?", "Can you reproduce analysis figure/table x?") |> 
  rename("data" = `Is the data available?`,
         "code" = "Is the code to run the analysis for Fig/Tab x available?",
         "reproduce" = "Can you reproduce analysis figure/table x?") %>%
  mutate(Journal = tolower(Journal),
         Journal = if_else(Journal == "amrican naturalist", "american naturalist", Journal),
         data = tolower(data),
         data = case_when(data == "na" ~ NA_character_,
                          data == "yes, but" ~ "yes",
                          TRUE ~ data),
         code = tolower(code),
         code = if_else(grepl("yes", code), "yes", code),
         reproduce = tolower(reproduce),
         reproduce = case_when(reproduce == "na" ~ NA_character_,
                               grepl("currently|six", reproduce) ~ "partly",
                               TRUE ~ reproduce),
         year = 2023)


dat24 <- read_excel(xlsx_path, sheet = "Hjerkinn_2024") |>
  select(Journal, `Is the data available?`, "Is the code to run the analysis for Fig/Tab x available?", "Can you reproduce analysis figure/table x?") |> 
  rename("data" = `Is the data available?`,
         "code" = "Is the code to run the analysis for Fig/Tab x available?",
         "reproduce" = "Can you reproduce analysis figure/table x?") %>%
  mutate(Journal = tolower(Journal),
         data = tolower(data),
         data = if_else(data == "n/a", NA_character_, data),
         code = tolower(code),
         code = case_when(code == "n/a" ~ NA_character_,
                          code == "na" ~ NA_character_,
                          TRUE ~ code),
         reproduce = tolower(reproduce),
         reproduce = case_when(reproduce == "na" ~ NA_character_,
                               grepl("code", reproduce) ~ NA_character_,
                               TRUE ~ reproduce),
         year = 2024) |> 
  filter(!is.na(Journal))


dat25 <- read_excel(xlsx_path, sheet = "Hjerkinn_2025") |>
  select(Journal, `Is the data available?`, "Is the code to run the analysis for Fig/Tab x available?", "Can you reproduce analysis figure/table x?") |> 
  rename("data" = `Is the data available?`,
         "code" = "Is the code to run the analysis for Fig/Tab x available?",
         "reproduce" = "Can you reproduce analysis figure/table x?") %>%
  mutate(Journal = tolower(Journal),
         Journal = if_else(Journal == "amrican naturalist", "american naturalist", Journal),
         data = tolower(data),
         data = case_when(data %in% c("na", "n/a") ~ NA_character_,
                          data == "yes, but" ~ "yes",
                          TRUE ~ data),
         code = tolower(code),
         code = case_when(code %in% c("na", "n/a") ~ NA_character_,
                          grepl("yes", code) ~ "yes",
                          code == "yea" ~ "yes",
                          TRUE ~ code),
         reproduce = tolower(reproduce),
         reproduce = case_when(reproduce %in% c("na", "n/a") ~ NA_character_,
                               grepl("currently|six", reproduce) ~ "partly",
                               grepl("code", reproduce) ~ NA_character_,
                               TRUE ~ reproduce),
         year = 2025) |> 
  filter(!is.na(Journal))


ss <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Rde3TsuFsExDmNNROZqslWVUOl_dXaLp4V-LnHq3Fyw"

dat26 <- read_sheet(ss, sheet = "Finse_2026") |>
  select(
    Journal,
    `Is the data available? Can it be located?`,
    `Is the code to run the analysis for Fig/Tab x available?`,
    `Can you reproduce analysis figure/table x?`
  ) |> 
  rename(
    "data" = `Is the data available? Can it be located?`,
    "code" = `Is the code to run the analysis for Fig/Tab x available?`,
    "reproduce" = `Can you reproduce analysis figure/table x?`
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Journal = tolower(Journal),
    Journal = if_else(Journal == "amrican naturalist", "american naturalist", Journal),
    data = tolower(data),
    data = case_when(
      data %in% c("na", "n/a") ~ NA_character_,
      data == "yes, but" ~ "yes",
      TRUE ~ data
    ),
    code = tolower(code),
    code = case_when(
      code %in% c("na", "n/a") ~ NA_character_,
      grepl("yes", code) ~ "yes",
      TRUE ~ code
    ),
    reproduce = tolower(reproduce),
    reproduce = case_when(
      reproduce %in% c("na", "n/a") ~ NA_character_,
      grepl("currently|six", reproduce) ~ "partly",
      grepl("code", reproduce) ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ reproduce
    ),
    year = 2026
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(Journal))


dat <- bind_rows(dat23, dat24, dat25, dat26) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(data, code, reproduce), names_to = "variable", values_to = "availability") |> 
  mutate(
    variable = factor(variable, levels = c("data", "code", "reproduce")),
    year = factor(year, levels = c(2023, 2024, 2025, 2026))
  ) |> 
  filter(!availability %in% c("yes, but"))
```


```{r}
#| label: journals
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

dat2 <- dat |> 
  filter(variable == "data") |> 
  group_by(Journal, year) |> 
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(dat2, aes(x = Journal, y = n, fill = Journal)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  facet_wrap(~ year)

```

```{r}
#| label: n-papers
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
#| output: asis

n_papers <- dat |> 
  filter(variable == "data") |> 
  count(year, name = "n")

counts <- paste0(n_papers$year, ": n = ", n_papers$n, collapse = ", ")
cat('<p style="font-size: 55%; margin-top: 0.4em;">', counts,
    "; total = ", sum(n_papers$n), "</p>\n", sep = "")
```

## 

```{r}
#| label: data-code-reproduce
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

dat |> 
  group_by(variable, availability, year) |> 
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = availability)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_wrap(~ variable)

```


## 

```{r}
#| label: per-journal
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

dat |> 
  group_by(Journal, variable, availability, year) |> 
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Journal, y = n, fill = availability)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_grid(variable ~ year)
```
